title: Show Clients the Finished Remodel Before They Sign
summary: Turn a photo of the client's room into a preview of the finished job with your own finishes and prices, then follow up on every quote so fewer jobs stall.

money_potential.label: High
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already sell remodels; the value is jobs that sign sooner and quotes that do not go quiet.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Clients who can see the result decide sooner.
Quotes that would go quiet get a follow-up on time.

stack.name: RoomFlip
stack.role: Makes a realistic preview of the remodel from a room photo and swaps finishes from your catalog with a running price.
stack.creator: teeRex247

stack.name: Quote Follow Up Sequence
stack.role: Sends quote follow-ups on a set schedule until the client replies.

steps.name: RoomFlip
steps.does: Shows the finished remodel with your finishes

steps.name: Quote Follow Up Sequence
steps.does: Follows up until the client replies

outputs: A remodel preview with a running price

steps: Load your finish catalog and prices.
Take a photo of the client's room at the first visit.
Show the preview and try two or three finish options together.
Send the quote and let the follow-ups run until the client replies.
guardrails: Tell clients the preview is an AI illustration, not a final design.
Check every price against your real quote before you send it.
